about: Dementia with Lewy bodies is recorded, and no rivastigmine is supplied in the whole history.
The record holds no dementia diagnosis and no rivastigmine supply, so the omission cannot be established.
Parkinson's disease dementia is recorded, and rivastigmine (Exelon patch) is supplied every month through the last six months, so nothing is missing.
Dementia with Lewy bodies still qualifies when vascular dementia is also recorded and no rivastigmine is supplied.
